messages:
Sam (eng): Quick check 10-day swap to Stockholm (March 2-11) to work from a partners place. Will I keep WFH stipend and is my health coverage OK for that short period? cc @Nora :flag-se:
Nora (People Ops): Short answer: likely yes for <2 weeks, but need the Temporary Location form. Also confirm youre keeping homebase as US in Workday. Any paid customer meetings while there?
Sam (eng): No meetings, just heads-down. Keeping US homebase.
Diego (Payroll): If it's under 14 days and homebase stays the same, payroll vendor usually doesn't need changes. Still send dates so we can log it. If you cross 30 days it starts getting sticky in some EU countries.
Marta (Benefits): Telemedicine works internationally; emergency care varies. For Sweden specifically: public care won't be covered unless you register locally. For a 10-day stay, our plan is fine. If you plan longer, contact Benefits for temporary coverage add-on.
Travel Bot: Reminder: submit Temporary Location form at least 5 business days before travel. Also file Travel Device change if using work laptop abroad.
Sam (eng): Filing form now. Appreciate the quick replies.
Nora (People Ops): Thanks Sam. Once form is in, Payroll will mark it and Benefits will note no action needed. If anything changes on duration, tell us ASAP.
Diego (Payroll): Logged. No payroll action required for this stay.
Marta (Benefits): Noted 10 days 10 coverage OK. DM me if you want contacts for expat clinics in Stockholm.
Sam (eng): Awesome, thanks all. :raised_hands:
